proposedComments.title: Make replacement injection and key pairing failure-safe
proposedComments.body:
### Make replacement injection and key pairing failure-safe

**Severity:** `high`

The replacement path currently releases and then re-synthesizes Shift, ignores SendInput failures, suppresses the trigger key-down without its matching key-up, and has no way to preserve multiple overlapping suppressed releases. This can leave modifiers stuck, expose unmatched key-up events, or partially delete the trigger when injection fails. Please release held text modifiers once, propagate injection success, suppress each matching physical key-up, preserve pending releases across settings reloads, and add held-Shift, failure, overlap, and reload regression tests.

proposedComments.title: Keep the matcher synchronized with the text users actually see
proposedComments.body:
### Keep the matcher synchronized with the text users actually see

**Severity:** `high`

The GeneratedByKBM early return means text replacement does not observe single-key-remap output or other Keyboard Manager text injection, while the buffered physical prefix remains live. The handler also runs before OS-level shortcut remaps. These paths let the buffer diverge from visible text and can backspace unrelated characters. Please give shortcut remaps priority and either feed downstream remap output into the matcher or clear the prefix whenever injected output cannot be represented, with regression coverage for key-to-key and key-to-text remaps.

proposedComments.title: Make text-replacement edits transactional
proposedComments.body:
### Make text-replacement edits transactional

**Severity:** `high`

Editing deletes the original native mapping and editor record before the replacement add/save succeeds. If either operation fails, the original is lost and retrying can fail because the old trigger is already gone. Please retain or restore the original mapping and settings on failure, remove the old editor record only after the replacement is committed, and surface enable/save failures instead of leaving UI and engine state inconsistent.

proposedComments.title: Reject unreachable trigger combinations and bound input sizes
proposedComments.body:
### Reject unreachable trigger combinations and bound input sizes

**Severity:** `medium`

A trigger that is a prefix of another trigger makes the longer mapping unreachable because replacement fires as soon as the shorter suffix matches. The editor and native loader should reject prefix conflicts consistently. Please also impose shared trigger/replacement length limits in both UI and native validation so persisted settings cannot create unbounded backspace or injection batches.

proposedComments.title: Rebase onto current main and rerun the x64 Debug chain
proposedComments.body:
### Rebase onto current main and rerun the x64 Debug chain

**Severity:** `high`

The branch contains merge commits from an older main and needs a current-main rebase before merge. In particular, the current Helpers::SendTextInput API requires the KeyboardManager input interface, so the replayed replacement call must pass it. Please resolve current-main API drift and rerun the PowerToys essentials, Keyboard Manager module/editor, and targeted test projects.

review.body:
Thanks for the detailed implementation, screenshots, and recording. Before this can merge, please address the following correctness issues:

- **[High] Current-main compatibility:** rebase onto current `main` and resolve the `Helpers::SendTextInput` API change by passing the Keyboard Manager input interface, then rerun the x64 Debug essentials/module/editor/test chain.
- **[High] Injection and key pairing:** do not re-synthesize Shift after replacement; propagate `SendInput` failure; suppress the physical key-up matching every suppressed trigger key-down; and preserve overlapping/pending releases across settings reloads.
- **[High] Matcher consistency:** keep the replacement buffer synchronized with single-key remap and key-to-text output, and give OS-level shortcut remaps priority so visible text cannot diverge from the buffered prefix.
- **[High] Transactional editing:** do not permanently delete the original replacement until the new native mapping and settings save succeed; restore it and surface an error on failure.
- **[Medium] Trigger validation:** reject prefix conflicts that make longer mappings unreachable, and enforce shared trigger/replacement length limits in UI and native settings loading.

Please also address the existing CapsLock/toggle-state thread. Regression coverage should include multi-character deletion, held Shift, injected/remapped output, failed injection, overlapping key releases, settings reload, edit rollback, and prefix conflicts.
